Worlds that diverge from our own at a single key reality—what if magic was real, history went differently, or the rules of life inverted.
A morally complex protagonist who lacks conventional heroic qualities but is compelling, relatable, and deeply human.
Stories set during or immediately after catastrophic world-ending events—civilisation on the brink of collapse.
Characters enter a marriage or committed relationship that was arranged by others rather than through mutual romantic choice.
Stories exploring the rise of AI—questions of consciousness, ethics, human-machine relationships, and existential risk.
Stories defined by conflict—epic battles, military strategy, and the brutal human cost of war.
The devastating wound of being betrayed by someone trusted—and what comes after: rage, grief, or revenge.
Ultra-wealthy love interests with lavish lifestyles, complicated power dynamics, and undeniable chemistry.
A wealthy, powerful executive falls for someone in their orbit—often an employee, rival, or unexpected match.
A single character is singled out by prophecy or special ability as the only person capable of fulfilling a critical destiny.

Stories centered on the formative journey from youth to maturity, featuring identity formation, first experiences, and the loss of innocence. Applies to fiction (bildungsroman) and nonfiction (memoir). Distinct from identity-and-belonging, which focuses on cultural/social identity at any age rather than the youth-to-adult transition.
Hidden plots, shadowy organizations, and dangerous secrets that powerful people will do anything to keep buried.
Stories centered on criminal acts, investigations, and the shadowy underworld of law, justice, and moral complexity.
Characters bound by ancient curses, prophecies, or inescapable fates—forced to fight destiny or surrender to it.
High-tech, low-life futures where corporate dystopia, hacking, and neon-lit streets define a gritty world of rebellion and survival.
Fantasy with a dark, gritty edge—morally complex characters, brutal worlds, and no guarantee of a happy ending.
A sharp investigator—professional or amateur—untangles clues and confronts danger to solve crimes and expose truth.
A thriller set within the home or family unit, exploring danger and dark dynamics between intimate partners or family.
Epic tales where dragons soar—as fearsome enemies, loyal companions, or sentient beings with their own kingdoms.
Stories set within dreams, the subconscious, or surreal dreamscapes where logic bends and imagination reigns.

A future or alternate society characterized by authoritarian control, surveillance, oppression, or extreme inequality—society is intact but deeply wrong. Distinct from post-apocalyptic (collapse after a disaster) in that dystopian worlds have functioning but oppressive governments or systems that are themselves the threat.
Two characters who begin as rivals or adversaries gradually develop romantic feelings for each other.
Grand adventures where heroes overcome impossible odds, traverse dangerous lands, and fulfill a world-changing destiny.
Spies, secret missions, double agents, and international intrigue where loyalty is always in question.
Discovery is the engine—uncharted lands, unfamiliar ideas, or unknown worlds pulling characters toward what they have not yet seen.
Characters pretend to be in a romantic relationship for external reasons, but genuine feelings develop over the course of the story.
Stories centered on the bonds of family—love, loyalty, sacrifice, conflict, and the complicated ties of blood.
Two characters are cosmically destined to be bonded partners, often through a supernatural soul bond or mate mark.
The intense, formative experience of falling in love for the very first time—often bittersweet and unforgettable.
Stories deeply rooted in folk traditions, fairy tales, oral myths, and cultural legends from around the world.
A romance between two people whose relationship is discouraged or prohibited due to circumstances such as family rivalry, class, or duty.
Characters who are not related by blood form a deep familial bond, creating their own chosen family unit.
Two people who share a close platonic friendship gradually discover and act on deeper romantic feelings for each other.
Stories set in the near or far future, exploring how technology, society, and humanity have evolved over time.
Stories exploring the ethical and existential consequences of manipulating DNA, creating engineered humans, or playing god.
Stories haunted by spirits of the dead—atmospheric, eerie, and often heartbreaking explorations of grief and the beyond.
Explores relationships, conflict, or power dynamics between divine or semi-divine beings and ordinary humans.
Narratives that sit with loss and mourning, exploring how characters carry, share, or are reshaped by what they have lost.
Eerie stories set in haunted places—houses, towns, or objects—where the past refuses to stay buried.
Stories of emotional recovery and personal growth, where characters move through pain toward wholeness.
A crew of skilled operatives plans and executes an elaborate theft, con, or criminal caper with style and precision.
A brave, noble protagonist who rises to face impossible odds, embodying courage, sacrifice, and the will to fight for good.
A character conceals who they truly are—a secret heritage, a buried past, a borrowed name—until the truth threatens to surface.
A romance set in a specific historical period using period-accurate settings, social norms, and cultural details.
Defiant optimism in the face of grimness—collective action, kindness as resistance, and the conviction that things can be made better.
The journey of self-discovery—figuring out who you are, where you belong, and how to live as that person.
A story in which a character is transported, reincarnated, or summoned into a parallel world or fantasy realm.
Physical or emotional odysseys where the journey itself transforms the traveler—as much about the path as the destination.
Three characters are involved in a romantic entanglement where one person is desired by two others simultaneously.
Stories where supernatural powers and mystical forces shape the world and drive the plot, from elemental sorcery to ancient enchantments.
Two characters wed for practical, political, or financial reasons—and gradually find unexpected feelings beneath the arrangement.
Stories where memory—its loss, distortion, or power—shapes identity, relationships, and the search for truth.
Stories featuring terrifying or sympathetic monsters, from classic creatures to entirely original beasts.
A puzzle-driven narrative where characters investigate a crime, unravel secrets, or solve an enigma against the clock.
Stories immersed in the myths and legends of ancient cultures—Greek, Norse, Egyptian, and beyond—brought vividly to life.
Stories set in forests, oceans, mountains, and untamed wild places where nature is both beautiful and dangerous.
Fiction targeting readers aged 18-25, bridging YA and adult fiction with themes of early independence and identity.
Moody, morally ambiguous crime stories set in shadowy urban worlds where everyone has a secret and trust is a luxury.
Humorous works that mock or lovingly skewer other genres, tropes, or stories through exaggeration and satire.
Lyrical, expressive prose that prioritizes rhythm, imagery, and emotional resonance over plot mechanics.
Power, betrayal, and statecraft drive the plot as factions maneuver behind the scenes, with alliances and secrets shifting in real time.
A love interest who is intensely devoted, often jealous and territorial over the person they love.
Set after a civilization-ending catastrophe; characters navigate a changed and dangerous world.
"The plot is driven by a foretelling or prediction that shapes characters' destinies and choices."
A powerful love interest who will do anything to keep the one they love safe—fiercely guarding them from any threat.
Inner conflicts, mental states, and the slippery line between perception and reality drive the narrative.
Characters rising up against oppressive systems, corrupt powers, or unjust rulers—fighting for freedom at great cost.
A character confronts past wrongs and works to atone, transforming guilt into change and earning a hard-won path forward.
Characters reborn into new lives—sometimes carrying memories, sometimes given a second chance to rewrite their fate.
"Centers on a character's drive to seek justice or retribution for a past wrong, and the personal cost of that pursuit."
Tales featuring androids, artificial beings, and mechanical minds questioning consciousness, identity, and what it means to be human.
Lighthearted, funny love stories full of misunderstandings, witty banter, and inevitable happily-ever-afters.
Glittering courts, noble bloodlines, and the intrigue of royal life—where power and love are equally dangerous.
A romance involving at least one royal or noble character, featuring court intrigue and the tension between love and obligation.
Sharp, witty commentary on society, politics, or culture wrapped in humor and irony to expose absurdity and hypocrisy.
Former lovers or estranged people reconnect and are given another opportunity to build a relationship after time apart.
Two characters must hide their romance from the world, adding tension and stolen moments to their love story.
Dark, psychologically intense stories involving the hunt for—or perspective of—a methodical killer.
A romance where attraction builds slowly over time, with deliberate tension and longing before the relationship fully develops.
Set in a tight-knit, intimate community where everyone knows each other; common in romance, mystery, and literary fiction.
Set in outer space or across star systems, featuring interstellar civilizations and grand adventure.
Stories set aboard spacecraft, space stations, or in the vast expanse between stars—exploring the final frontier.
"Epic military conflicts fought across planets, star systems, and the void of space—humanity's battles gone interstellar."
Stories where ghosts, demons, magic, or otherworldly forces blur the line between the living and the dead.
Focuses on characters facing extreme threats to their existence, and the lengths they go to in order to survive.
Action-packed fantasy featuring mighty warriors, powerful sorcerers, and epic battles in richly imagined worlds.
High-stakes stories packed with tension, suspense, and plot twists that keep readers on the edge of their seats.
Characters journey through time—to the past, the future, or alternate timelines—with world-changing consequences.
A love story defined by heartbreak, loss, or an ending that cannot be—beautifully devastating and deeply emotional.
Fantasy set in a contemporary real-world setting where magical elements exist hidden within everyday life.
Dark, seductive tales featuring immortal bloodsuckers navigating love, power, and survival across centuries.
Characters navigate digital worlds, immersive simulations, or online universes where reality and fiction collide.
Stories featuring werewolves, shapeshifters, and pack dynamics—often blending romance, action, and supernatural tension.
Stories featuring witches, covens, and magic traditions—from dark and dangerous to cozy and whimsical.
Stories set against the backdrop of the World Wars—exploring courage, loss, love, and the human cost of global conflict.
